notes: Routing metadata only: the role route composes exactly one role source and one applicable operation source.
Core metadata records source ownership; shared core blocks are not injected into role capsules; the digest accompanies the capsule in the first message.
Canonical task references and workspace bindings travel in the handover as data, separate from instruction blocks.
The manifest names eight launchable roles and nine operations; role and operation applicability must agree.
Paseo is the host. Role agents start and message each other with the AR tools role_start and role_message on the agents-remember-task tool server.
